abstract: Build, serve, tune, update and troubleshoot ik_llama.cpp, the llama.cpp fork with IQK and trellis quants, fast CPU and hybrid CPU/GPU MoE inference, split-mode graph and speculative decoding. Covers prebuilt images, CMake (CPU, CUDA, AVX-512), llama-server flags and API, offload planning, llama-swap and LiteLLM. References are split by task.
